groups.defect: add_members/remove_member call params.require(:group_id), but the suggestions say the members routes in config/routes.rb supply :id. They conclude that real requests will fail with ParameterMissing.

answer.reasoning: All three suggestions report the same defect: the routes are said to supply :id, but add_members and remove_member call params.require(:group_id). Each one names both endpoints, either directly or with "same for remove_member", and they propose the same fixes: read :id in the controller, change the route, or send group_id. Their line ranges overlap (65-67, 65-86, 65-70) in the same file, so this is same_location. Whether the claim is right doesn't matter for grouping. Rails actually nests bare verb routes inside a resources block as :group_id, so the claim is probably wrong. needsUnifiedComment is false because every member covers the same overlapping region and already describes the whole issue. Any one of them would be a complete comment, and a single route-level change would resolve all three. The grouping is clear; only the needsUnifiedComment flag is close (the two judges split on it).
